title: Component assembly for the normalized direct-image square
statement:
theorem normalizedDirectImageSquare_component
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (gX : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : gX ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ))
    (h₁ : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (gX ≫ f).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
      (schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso gX f).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit (Scheme.Modules.pushforward gX)
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)).app K)
    (h₂ : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f' ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
      (schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso f' g).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f')
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g)).app K)
    (ht : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (gX ≫ f).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ schemeDerivedDirectImage v) h)).app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
          (directImageSquareIso gX f f' g h).hom (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f' ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) :
    (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit (Scheme.Modules.pushforward gX)
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)).app K ≫
      (schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso gX f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) ≫
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ schemeDerivedDirectImage v) h)).app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) ≫
      (schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso f' g).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
    DerivedCategory.Qh.map
      ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp gX f ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f' g).symm).hom (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f')
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g)).app K := by sorry

source.place: Tag 0D5T, pasting the two composition comparisons with equality transport.

proof.text: Abbreviate the two single-unit components by a and b, the two pasted-unit components by U and V, the two normalized comparison components by c and d, and the equality-transport component by t. Write m for the localized ordinary square map in ht. The hypotheses are a ≫ c.inv = U, b ≫ d.inv = V, and a ≫ t = m ≫ b. Substitute h₁ into the left side to obtain a ≫ c.inv ≫ c.hom ≫ t ≫ d.inv. Associativity and c.inv ≫ c.hom = 𝟙 reduce this to a ≫ t ≫ d.inv. Substitute ht to get m ≫ b ≫ d.inv, and then h₂ to get m ≫ V. This uses no cancellation of a unit and no invertibility of a, b, or t.

source.place: Tag 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); elementary component pasting, not its existence proof

proof.text: By definition directImageSquareIso gX f f′ g h is pushforwardComp gX f ≪≫ pushforwardCongr h ≪≫ (pushforwardComp f′ g).symm. Expanding this abbreviation in m gives exactly the map on the displayed right-hand side. Hence the equation from step 1 is the desired component equation.
